title: End of session
summary: Leave the instrument safe and documented for the next person. Placeholder content written from general AFM practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Confirm the head is raised
steps.body: Check the Z stage position in the software and look at the gap between probe and sample yourself.
steps.check: I can see clear space between the probe and the sample

steps.title: Remove your sample
steps.body: Lift the sample disk off the chuck by its edge with tweezers. Slide it sideways first to break the magnetic hold, rather than pulling straight up.

steps.title: Log the session
steps.body: Record which probe is installed, its condition, and anything the next user should know. If you think the probe is worn, say so. If you exchanged a probe, record the removed probe and its placement in the used-probe box, along with the replacement probe identifier.

steps.title: Close the enclosure door
steps.body: Close the enclosure door and clear tweezers and sample boxes off the bench.

steps.title: Leave the software idle
steps.body: Leave the software idle. The laser may stay on if the local SOP permits it.
